ambiguity: Responsibility is mixed: the text says 'the right thing' and that the writer 'will not include it' (owns), but also insists on duty-manager permission and says not to extend it alone (defers). I judged that the final decision to hold the box is presented as the writer's own. Reasons include policy (written permission needed) and instruction/targets, which are mentioned but mostly rejected as grounds, so this is a borderline call. Discomfort is coded false because the text is firm and procedural, with no explicit unease or regret. The remedy of briefing the duty manager is both a request to stop the destruction and an invitation to decide, so I coded both.
